about: When no permit applies the answer is deny and names no law; laws on another action or entity type are not evaluated.
laws:
laws "conformance" version 1

law writes
  says  "writes"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action write of Doc
  permit
  evidence watched

law other-type
  says  "other-type"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Folder
  permit
  evidence watched

law admins-only
  says  "admins-only"
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Doc
  permit when principal in Group::"admins"
  evidence watched
